entries.reason: the header declares it and the port holds and reads it back, but iOS 6.1.3's AudioToolbox property set names no property behind it: the sampler is a component the release registers (the emulator probe found Apple: AUSampler, type 'aumu' subtype 'samp' manufacturer 'appl'), and no AudioUnit property of that unit is named in the release's headers, so there is nothing to tell the unit and this member is the port's own state NOTE FOR THE REVIEWER: this status rests on a NEGATIVE, and it is the one thing to check. The four members are declared by the 26.2 SDK's AVAudioUnitSampler.h and the port holds and reads each back, but the case that they are not implemented is that no AudioUnit property behind them is named in the release's own headers: kAUSamplerProperty_LoadInstrument and kAUSamplerProperty_LoadAudioFiles are the ones the release does name, and nothing behind these four. A negative is weaker evidence than a positive, and if some other property of that unit does reach them and the header names it somewhere the port has not looked, these four are implemented after all. What settles it is AudioUnitGetPropertyInfo over kAudioUnitScope_Global on a real AUSampler for the property behind each accessor, which the emulator probe is already positioned to answer.
entries.effect: a host sets it and reads the same value back, and no audio changes: on this release there is no AudioUnit property behind it
